datasets.title: Gas and mass of Abell 1689
datasets.description: The Chandra X-ray Center's 2008 picture of Abell 1689 in its layers, with ESA/Hubble's lensing mass map: the hot gas in purple and the mass in blue. Each is drawn on ellipsoidal shells of the shape Umetsu et al. (2015) fitted to lensing, X-ray and Sunyaev-Zel'dovich measurements together: ellipses on the sky, 1.22 (gas) and 1.19 (mass) times as long along the sight line as their long axis. That length is measured for the cluster as a whole; where a pixel's light lies within the shells is not. The galaxies of the Hubble picture, the Milky Way's stars removed, each stand at a depth drawn from the mass's shells: no measurement places a galaxy along the sight line.
datasets.summary: Purple is X-ray gas and blue is lensing mass, on shells as long along the sight line as the cluster was measured to be.

facts.label: Colors
facts.value: Purple: hot gas in X-rays (Chandra). Blue: mass from gravitational lensing (Hubble)
